Region: São Paulo state. No official animal poison line found (CIATox/CEATOX are human lines). No duty rotas. Not done: many private 24 h hospitals in São Paulo city (Hospital Veterinário Rebouças, Pompeia, Prontvet, Santa Inês, Vet Popular, Dog Up, Vet Caldas, Vetnasa, Paes de Barros) because clinic sites could not be fetched (only URLs surfaced by search can be opened) - leads from Catraca Livre; Campinas private hospitals, Santos/Baixada (municipal hospital still under construction in 2025, Bom Retiro), Ribeirão Preto private 24 h (Marcovet, VFP, Bmvet), PUC-Campinas hospital (24 h contract with city for rescued animals, Campus II, Jardim Ipaussurama), UNESP Araçatuba/Botucatu/Jaboticabal, UNIP, Anhembi Morumbi, Guarujá, other states of Brazil. | Follow-up 2026-11-09: Method: WebSearch (allowed_domains per clinic to surface own-site URLs) + WebFetch of every page used.
